title: Air Force captain Oliveira at the national war college

tellings.quote: in 1954 actually in the Escola superior degera you know basically the national war college here there was an air force captain Olivivera and he said this phenomena is real

plain: In 1954, at Brazil's national war college, the Escola Superior de Guerra, an Air Force captain named Oliveira said that the UFO phenomenon is real. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as evidence that Brazil's military was taking the subject seriously very early.
